claim: On July 19, 2023 the developer guide history recorded that you could use Local Zones with geoproximity routing (traffic flow only) after you enable them. The current guide also offers Local Zone Groups for geoproximity records: for AWS resources you specify the AWS Region or Local Zone Group that you created the resource in, and you must first enable Local Zones.

qualifiers.condition: Local Zones must be enabled first

evidence.quote: July 19, 2023 You can now use Local Zones with geoproximity routing (traffic flow only) after you enable them.
If you're using AWS resources, specify the AWS Region or Local Zone Group that you created the resource in.
To use AWS Local Zones, you have to first enable them.
**AWS Local Zone Group** Choose an available Local Zone Group from the **Location** list.
